addresses.comment: A text cell (text +4; +0x1F icon flag and +0x20 frame from args; sort string empty so +0xB0 stays 1).
addresses.evidence: Decompiled.

addresses.name: CTableLedgerItem_CtorFaction
addresses.no_signature: stack: this, shown text, then two strings; ret undetermined
addresses.comment: A text cell with a sort string (+0x28) and icon name (+0x44) - the faction cell uses it; +0xB6 is an extra flag.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled.

addresses.name: CTableLedgerItem_CtorFloat
addresses.no_signature: stack: this, value float, percent byte, text; ret undetermined
addresses.comment: A float cell: +0x20 the value; shown via FormatFloat(1) or, where the percent byte (+0xB3) is set, `itoa(value*100) + '%'`; sorted by float (+0xB2).
addresses.evidence: Decompiled.

addresses.name: CTableLedgerItem_CtorInt
addresses.no_signature: stack: this, integer, text; ret undetermined
addresses.comment: An int cell: +0x24 the value and the same number as text +4, sorted by int (+0xB1).
addresses.evidence: Decompiled.

structs.name: CStatisticsLedger
structs.comment: The statistics ledger window's controller; created and destroyed around CInGameIdler +0x1CE0.
structs.evidence: operator_new(0x2F8) at 0x673513; vftable 0x15DC714 is CStatisticsLedger in the RTTI export.

structs.name: CGraphicalTableLedger
structs.comment: A table on a ledger page: headers, rows, a scrollbar.
structs.evidence: operator_new(0x150) in every table page; vftable from RTTI.

structs.name: CPieChartLedgerGraphical
structs.comment: One pie of a ledger pie page.
structs.evidence: operator_new(0xfc) at the pages' construction; vftable from RTTI.

structs.name: CTableLedgerItem
structs.comment: A cell of a ledger table.
structs.evidence: Cell vectors step 0xB8 (FUN_00794130's copy; FUN_007be860's stride).

struct_fields.name: page
struct_fields.comment: Current ledger page, 0..25. Written by the constructor and every button. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topscreens.md, section B.
struct_fields.evidence: Read in the decompilation cited in the comment; a wrong reading would show as a different use of the offset.

struct_fields.name: building_mode

struct_fields.name: statistics_ledger

struct_fields.name: ledger_close_requested

struct_fields.name: ledger_last_page

struct_fields.name: ledger_sort_columns

struct_fields.name: ledger_sort_ascending
